body:
Found in an independent adversarial review of #1007 (head `612860e4`). Low.

**What happens:** #1009 asked for symlink-alias regressions for duplicate successor-review output destinations. The new tests cover only a lexical `..` alias.

**Suggested fix:** add a test where two destinations differ textually but resolve to the same file through a symlink, and assert that it is rejected before the dictionary is built.
title: Add a symlink-alias regression for duplicate successor-review destinations
